technology_name: Sustainable & High-Potency Dried Mushrooms Powder for the Future
problem_solved: Short fresh market windows, high contamination risk, and technical barriers in rural mushroom cultivation that limit enterprise scalability and grower income.
description: An end-to-end scientific mushroom cultivation and value-addition model that combines agricultural biotechnology with decentralized production systems. The technology features the production of certified, high-purity, contamination-free spawn and pre-sterilized, inoculated "ready-to-fruit" mushroom beds that reduce setup complexity for growers. The model incorporates standardized post-harvest dehydration and powdering techniques designed to eliminate perishability while retaining peak flavor, texture, and nutritional profiles.
applications:
• Commercial manufacturing of high-protein, functional mushroom powders and dried foods

• Distribution networks for pre-sterilized, ready-to-fruit domestic and commercial growing kits

• B2B supply of certified, genetically pure mushroom spawn to large-scale cultivation operations

• Sourcing of natural savory flavor-enhancers and micronutrient additives for the FMCG food sector
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
